# Sylow subgroup　`def.sylow-subgroup`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.sylow-subgroup)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.sylow-subgroup.md)

## Notes · **draft**
⭐ Existence, conjugacy and counting are in `thm.sylow`; this node only defines the object.

⭐ Example: in $S_3$ ($|S_3| = 6 = 2 \cdot 3$) the Sylow $3$-subgroups are $A_3$ (unique, hence normal), and the Sylow $2$-subgroups are the three subgroups of order $2$ generated by the three transpositions.

⚠ A $p$-subgroup is a subgroup whose order is a prime power; a Sylow $p$-subgroup is the **largest** such subgroup, and a group may have several Sylow $p$-subgroups.

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
